admission_rules: Inspect actual quota before and after one isolated session; do not charge multiple simultaneous jobs while calibrating.
Prefer one loaded model with arm/adapter switching; explicit output identity prevents stale-output reuse.
Reserve save time plus one observed p90/max query before starting a query; no hard mid-update termination.
Use per-stage caps and exit immediately after staged outputs are saved, avoiding idle GPU while humans decide.
If loading is anomalously slow, record heartbeat and abort/replan within a pre-agreed session allowance; do not silently consume the 6h reserve.
New reasoning/program-agent cost cannot be inferred from 4.3 token/s short grid decode; establish a small token/time cap pilot before expanding.
